version_notes: v6.2.0 (2026-10-22): job-outreach joins as the 9th skill (8th member): recruiter, hiring-manager, and contact messages in the user's own voice, checked by check_voice.py against the user's voice/rules.json and by the anti-fabrication gate. Routing: application check-ins and thank-you notes stay with application-tracker; messages to recruiters and contacts, and voice checks of any draft, go to job-outreach. The description drops '(for example on a new machine)' and shortens resume-tailor's clause to stay under 1024 characters. v6.1.0 (2026-10-21) is the first GitHub release of the 8-skill family: v6.0.0 (2026-05-28) split the v5.2.0 monolith into an orchestrator plus 5 members, and cover-letter (2026-05-29) and interview-prep (2026-10-18) joined later. This is the orchestrator: it owns the .job-hunter/ workspace lifecycle (init/export/import), routes a job-search task to the right member specialists (career-profile, job-search, resume-tailor, cover-letter, application-tracker, interview-prep, outcome-learning), and enforces the anti-fabrication family invariant. Members each work standalone; the orchestrator routes + merges.
